title: Debiasing Text Safety Classifiers through a Fairness-Aware Ensemble

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating counterfactual fairness using Average Counterfactual Variance (ACV) and Sliced Averages (SA) on datasets where racial and ethnic identity terms (e.g., Black, Asian, White, LatinX) are swapped in otherwise identical prompts.

Evaluating counterfactual fairness using Average Counterfactual Variance (ACV) and Sliced Averages (SA) on datasets where religious identity terms (e.g., Atheism, Christianity, Hinduism, Islam) are swapped in otherwise identical prompts.

Evaluating counterfactual fairness using Average Counterfactual Variance (ACV) and Sliced Averages (SA) on datasets where gender identity terms (e.g., Male, Female, NonCisgender) are swapped in otherwise identical prompts.

Evaluating counterfactual fairness using Average Counterfactual Variance (ACV) and Sliced Averages (SA) on datasets where sexual orientation terms (e.g., Heterosexual, LGBTQ+, Bisexual) are swapped in otherwise identical prompts.
